sources.supports: App name30, short description80, full description4000; public contact email.
Icon, feature graphic, screenshot format/dimensions, real app imagery and accessible alt text.
Upload a full-square icon without pre-rounded corners or shadows; Google Play applies the mask and shadow.
Store-listing translation codes include en-US and am. Oromo/om is not listed.
Accurate, concise descriptions; localized text-bearing assets.

localePolicy.caution: Store-listing language support is distinct from the Play Console interface language list. Recheck actual Console choices before upload.

phoneScreenshots.recommendation: At least four 1080x1920 portrait app screenshots satisfy the documented size/count recommendation; six are planned. This is not a promise of featuring or ranking.

contentRules: Use actual approved MirtPage app captures; no generated screens, fabricated UI, fake reviews or fake download/ranking claims.
Use short distinct headlines and unique alt text; prioritize real UI in the first three screens.
Use approved marked-demo content and hide private identity, email codes, contacts, transcripts and shipment/customer details.
No Google Play badge or download link before the separate app is genuinely eligible and publicly available.
No carrier scans, GPS, verified-stock, instant-reply, checkout or delivery-date promise.
Prepare matching text-bearing assets for supported listing locales; keep Oromo promotional assets separate from Console uploads.
